CREATE TABLE `ticket` (
  `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '工单 ID',
  `title` VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL COMMENT '标题',
  `status` ENUM('open','processing','done') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' COMMENT '状态',
  `priority` ENUM('high','normal','low') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal' COMMENT '优先级',
  `customer_name` VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '客户名称',
  `due_at` DATETIME NULL COMMENT '截止时间',
  `tags` JSON COMMENT '标签',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
notes: COMMENT → label；NOT NULL → required；ENUM → Select + dataOptions；表级 PRIMARY KEY 整条跳过；JSON → Input + 告警。
